supported.label: Supported
supported.means: Automatic capture through lifecycle hooks, plus the memory tools over MCP.

mcp-only.label: MCP-only
mcp-only.means: The agent can search and write memory. It exposes no lifecycle hooks, so nothing is captured automatically.

hooks-only.label: Hooks-only
hooks-only.means: Sessions are captured automatically. The agent has no MCP client to query memory with.

managed-only.label: Managed-only
managed-only.means: Works when launched through `ai-memory run`. There is no separate hook installer.

community.label: Community
community.means: A plugin maintained by the community, not installed by ai-memory itself.

experimental.label: Experimental
experimental.means: It ships and it works, with rough edges you should expect.

linux.name: Linux
linux.note: x86_64 and ARM64. Native binary, Docker or Podman, AUR packages with systemd units.

macos.name: macOS
macos.note: Apple Silicon and Intel. Native binary with a launchd agent, Docker, or a menu bar app you build from source.

windows-via-wsl2.name: Windows via WSL2
windows-via-wsl2.note: Follow the Linux path inside WSL2 and launch your agent from there.

native-windows.name: Native Windows
native-windows.note: Release zip with ai-memory.exe, the Docker Desktop wrapper, or a source build. The zip upgrades itself with ai-memory upgrade.

claude-code.note: Hooks and MCP. Optional session-aware routing.

codex.note: Hooks and MCP. Session end is wired from Codex CLI 0.145.0.

opencode.note: Remote MCP and a generated TypeScript plugin.

opencode2.note: Plugin for the 2.0.10+ event API, checked against 2.0.14. Every finished turn refreshes the summary and the handoff.

grok.note: Capture works. The handoff arrives with the first tool call.

devin.note: Hooks and MCP, including post-compaction capture.

kimi-code.note: Ten hook events. Handoffs inject on the first prompt.

kiro-cli.note: Both the v2 and v3 engines. Closes on exit under ai-memory run.

command-code.note: MCP and four hook events, with native resume. Closes on exit under ai-memory run.

antigravity-cli.note: Under ai-memory run the session closes on exit. Otherwise, finalize-session.

pi.note: A generated extension gives capture and an MCP bridge.

omp.note: Native MCP and a TypeScript extension.

openclaw.note: MCP config and native plugin hooks.

crush.note: Launch it with ai-memory run crush.

pool.note: Paste a generated hooks snippet into its settings.

vscode-copilot.note: Copilot exposes no lifecycle hooks yet.

hermes.note: The hook installer prints a block for ~/.hermes/config.yaml. Recall and handoffs come from the community plugin.
